caption: Blue domes, white walls and a sunset that lasted forever. Santorini, you win.
Lemons the size of your head and roads with no guardrails. Amalfi coast done right.
Rainy Tuesday, bowl of tonkotsu. Nothing else matters.
First time at the sea. Verdict: too wet, would go again.
Grilled octopus, a carafe of white and nowhere to be. Crete does slow living best.
Climbed 463 steps for this view of Florence. Legs gone, heart full.
Morning light through the pines. Phone on silent, finally.
10k before 7am. Not fast, just done.
Ferry hopping between the Cyclades. Each island a different shade of blue.
Got lost in Venice on purpose. Found a bakery. No regrets.
New flat white spot near the office. Latte art slightly suspicious.
Repotting day. The monstera has officially outgrown me.
Water so clear you can count the pebbles. Zakynthos, late September.
Cacio e pepe in a Rome trattoria with four tables. Three ingredients, zero notes.
Supervising the neighbourhood from the windowsill. Nothing gets past her.
Still water, cold swim, warm tea after. The Lakes in October.
Acropolis at opening time, before the heat and the crowds. Worth the alarm.
Hiking the Dolomites. Every corner looks like a painting.
Sunday brunch: eggs, sourdough, far too much hot sauce.
Day 30 of stretching before coffee. Can now touch my toes. Barely.
Oia at golden hour. Everyone clapped when the sun went down.
Pistachio and fior di latte, twice a day. It's a cultural obligation.
Rooftop after the rain. The whole city glows.
Blanket, book, tea. Plans cancelled, happily.
